journeys.title: Self Assessment
journeys.description: Find out if you need to file and what to prepare.

steps.prompt: Which best describes you this tax year?
What extra income do you have?
Are you already registered for Self Assessment?
Did HMRC send you a notice to file, or do you have untaxed income?

steps.summary_template: Based on your answers, Self Assessment may be relevant. I can explain deadlines, registration, or TaxSimba SA package prices — without pressure to buy.

How do I register for Self Assessment?

journeys.title: Making Tax Digital
journeys.description: Understand MTD for Income Tax at a high level.

steps.prompt: Are you mainly self-employed, a landlord, or both?
Do you already keep digital records (software or spreadsheets suited to MTD)?

steps.summary_template: MTD for Income Tax involves digital records and quarterly updates for eligible people. Exact start dates and thresholds depend on HMRC rules for your situation — always check GOV.UK. I can share TaxSimba MTD plan prices if helpful.
follow_ups: What is Making Tax Digital for Income Tax?
What do TaxSimba MTD plans cost?

journeys.title: Landlords
journeys.description: Property income tax basics for UK landlords.

steps.prompt: What kind of property income do you have?

options.label: Not sure how to classify it

steps.prompt: Do you already file Self Assessment for your property income?

steps.summary_template: UK property income is often reported through Self Assessment. Keep records of rent and allowable costs. MTD may also become relevant depending on HMRC rules. I can explain SA basics or share package prices if you want.
follow_ups: Do landlords need to file Self Assessment?
What is Making Tax Digital for landlords?
Can I speak to an accountant for £99?

steps.prompt: Have you started freelancing this tax year, or have you been self-employed longer?
Roughly, is freelancing your main income or a smaller side income?

steps.summary_template: Freelancers usually need to consider Self Assessment, record-keeping, and National Insurance. I can cover deadlines and registration using GOV.UK sources, or outline TaxSimba SA prices if useful.
follow_ups: Do freelancers need to register for Self Assessment?

What does TaxSimba Self Assessment Simple cost?

steps.prompt: Are you a CIS subcontractor, a contractor, or not sure?
Do you already complete a Self Assessment tax return?

steps.summary_template: CIS deductions are not the final tax position for many subcontractors — Self Assessment often brings everything together. Keep payment and deduction statements. I can explain SA basics from GOV.UK or share support package prices.
follow_ups: Do CIS subcontractors need Self Assessment?
